observations.behavior: Adds three new Lightdash endpoint configurations: explores, schedulers, scheduler_runs, including their metadata, pagination, and incremental field handling.
observations.code_quote: "description": "A Lightdash explore: a queryable table compiled from a dbt model, with its warehouse location and any compilation errors. Field definitions are not included.",
observations.posthog_connection: Adds ingestion of Lightdash explore metadata, scheduled delivery definitions, and scheduled delivery run history, including incremental merge support for bounded 7-day windows.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function to construct pagination parameters and its use in endpoint configuration, replacing inline parameter construction.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports paginated Lightdash endpoints with configurable page size, while preserving parent endpoints that do not support pagination.

observations.behavior: Updates comments to clarify that Lightdash lacks server-side updated-since filters, and that rows arrive in natural or ascending order.
